path.data-text: REFERENCE RENDITION · INK #0A0A0A ON WHITE PAPER
SAMPLE CODE O26-J-900001 · KEY ID 1 · PUBLIC SAMPLE KEY · A VERIFIER MUST ANSWER INVALID SIGNATURE OR UNKNOWN
RESULTS · SUCCESSFUL READS OUT OF 3 ATTEMPTS PER CELL
2X ZOOM · IF THE SCANNER OFFERS IT
WRITE 3/3, 2/3, 1/3 OR 0/3 · LEAVE BLANK IF NOT TESTED · WRITE > WHEN THE CODE DOES NOT FIT INSIDE THE ON-SCREEN ORBIT AT THAT DISTANCE
DISTANCE = PHONE LENS TO TAG, PHONE PARALLEL TO THE TAG · A READ = ANY RESULT SCREEN WITHIN 10 S · CUT THE TAG OUT OR MASK THE OTHER CODES FIRST
THIS PAGE SIMULATES WHITE PAPER, CARD AND CERTIFICATES ON PAPER · CONFIRM ON THE REAL MATERIAL BEFORE FIXING A MINIMUM SIZE
